items.name: install
items.title: Install card
items.description: Add to home screen in whatever form the browser supports: Chromium's prompt, iOS's two taps, or out of an in-app browser.
items.docs: Call captureInstallPrompt() from @/lib/install in your client entry, before React mounts: Chromium fires beforeinstallprompt once and early.

items.name: app-assets
items.title: Icons and splash screens
items.description: Icons, favicon, maskable icon and every Apple splash screen from one logo and one background colour, the same colour the manifest and index.html's first paint use.
items.docs: Set background (the app's page colour as hex) and logo in pwa-assets.config.ts, put <!-- pwa-assets:start --> and <!-- pwa-assets:end --> in index.html's head, then run bun scripts/generate-assets.ts after every logo change. Give the manifest the same background as background_color and theme_color. vite.config.ts: appBackground(background) from ./vite-app-background, and index.html gets <meta name="theme-color" content="%APP_BG%"> and <style>html { background: %APP_BG% }</style> in its head. No in-app logo screen after the splash: on iOS it shows after white frames and reads as a second splash (pwa skill, Launch traps).
